description: This file declares the NgHttp2Adapter class, which implements an HTTP/2 adapter interface using nghttp2 library. It provides methods for creating client/server adapters, processing data, submitting settings, pings, window updates, and managing streams.

classes.name: NgHttp2Adapter
classes.description: A class implementing an HTTP/2 adapter interface using nghttp2, supporting client/server modes and stream management.

methods.name: ~NgHttp2Adapter
methods.description: Destructor for NgHttp2Adapter.

methods.name: CreateClientAdapter
methods.description: Creates an adapter configured as an HTTP/2 client.

methods.name: CreateServerAdapter
methods.description: Creates an adapter configured as an HTTP/2 server.

methods.name: IsServerSession
methods.description: Returns true if the session is a server session.

methods.name: want_read
methods.description: Indicates if the adapter wants to read data.

methods.name: want_write
methods.description: Indicates if the adapter wants to write data.

methods.name: ProcessBytes
methods.description: Processes incoming bytes.

methods.name: SubmitSettings
methods.description: Submits HTTP/2 settings.

methods.name: SubmitPriorityForStream
methods.description: Sets priority for a stream.

methods.name: SubmitPing
methods.description: Sends a PING frame.

methods.name: SubmitShutdownNotice
methods.description: Submits a shutdown notice.

methods.name: SubmitGoAway
methods.description: Sends a GOAWAY frame.

methods.name: SubmitWindowUpdate
methods.description: Updates flow control window.

methods.name: SubmitRst
methods.description: Resets a stream.

methods.name: SubmitMetadata
methods.description: Submits metadata for a stream.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends data.

methods.name: GetSendWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the send window size.

methods.name: GetStreamSendWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the send window size for a specific stream.

methods.name: GetStreamReceiveWindowLimit
methods.description: Returns the receive window limit for a stream.

methods.name: GetStreamReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the receive window size for a stream.

methods.name: GetReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the overall receive window size.

methods.name: GetHpackEncoderDynamicTableSize
methods.description: Returns HPACK encoder table size.

methods.name: GetHpackDecoderDynamicTableSize
methods.description: Returns HPACK decoder table size.

methods.name: GetHighestReceivedStreamId
methods.description: Returns the highest stream ID received.

methods.name: MarkDataConsumedForStream
methods.description: Marks data as consumed for flow control.

methods.name: SubmitRequest
methods.description: Submits a request with headers and data.

methods.name: SubmitResponse
methods.description: Submits a response with headers and data.

methods.name: SubmitTrailer
methods.description: Submits trailer headers.

methods.name: SetStreamUserData
methods.description: Associates user data with a stream.

methods.name: GetStreamUserData
methods.description: Retrieves user data associated with a stream.

methods.name: ResumeStream
methods.description: Resumes a paused stream.

methods.name: RemoveStream
methods.description: Removes a stream from the adapter.

methods.name: sources_size
methods.description: Returns the number of data sources.
